title: AI-visibility observation
description: One AI answer to one prompt, on one platform, at one moment. Stored one per line in data/aeo/results/<runId>.jsonl. Auto-detected fields (companyMentioned, companyCited, sourceUrls, positionInAnswer, competitorsMentioned) are a first pass; a human reviewer fills sentiment, accuracyIssues and recommendationType and may correct the rest. One observation is never a ranking: see docs/aeo/measurement-plan.md.

example.description: true marks a placeholder row. report.mjs skips every row with example: true.

promptId.description: Id from data/aeo/prompts.json (AEO-...) or a branded-prompt id (BR-...).

prompt.description: Exact text sent, copied from the catalog.

branded.description: true when the prompt names the company. Reported separately from non-branded prompts.

platform.description: Consumer app (chatgpt, claude, perplexity, gemini, google-ai-overview, google-ai-mode, copilot) or API (*-api). Keep the two apart: API answers are not what a logged-in homeowner sees.

model.description: Model id returned by the API, or the model label shown in the app ("unknown" if the app does not say).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the answer was received.

locationContext.description: Location the platform was given or inferred. For manual runs, where the device actually was (and VPN, if any).

sessionType.description: new = logged out, incognito, or a fresh account / API call with no memory. personalized = a logged-in account with history or memory.

companyMentioned.description: The answer text names Houston Superior Painting.

companyCited.description: A cited or linked source is on houstonsuperiorpainting.com.

positionInAnswer.description: 1-based order in which our company appears among the companies named in the answer. null when not mentioned.

recommendationType.description: recommended = the answer suggests hiring or contacting us; mentioned = named neutrally or in a list without endorsement; none = not named.

sentiment.description: Human review only. null until reviewed.

competitorsMentioned.description: Other painting or remodeling companies named, in order of appearance.

sourceUrls.description: Every URL the answer cited or linked, in order, de-duplicated.

accuracyIssues.description: Human review only. Wrong facts about us (phone, service area, warranty, prices, services, a look-alike domain). null = not reviewed yet; [] = reviewed, nothing wrong.

field.description: e.g. phone, warranty, serviceArea, price, services, website, owner

rawResponse.description: Full answer text (manual runs) or the full API response body (API runs). Never edited.

answerText.description: Extracted plain answer text, for review.

screenshotRef.description: Path or link to the screenshot of a manual observation.

reviewed.description: true once a human has checked the auto-detected fields and filled sentiment and accuracyIssues.

runId.description: Groups the observations of one measurement round, e.g. 2026-10-baseline or 2026-11-day30. Also the file name.

sampleIndex.description: 1..N when the same prompt is asked several times in the same run (we ask 3 times).

error.description: Set when the call failed. Rows with an error are excluded from the rates.
